methods.name: Peer-Median

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
WeaveGrid is a Series B climate and energy company that has raised $78M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (Linamar Corp, LNZA), with direct stage-matched peers including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, which applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yields $148M based on total raised as a proxy for current value. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, adjacent-stage comparables produces a $1.0B midpoint valuation, with the peer cohort ranging from $700M (Amogy, Series C) to $3.0B (KoBold Metals, Series C). The divergence reflects heterogeneity in commercialization progress and capital intensity within frontier energy.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $126M to $1.1B, with a median point estimate of $574M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around two dimensions: (1) WeaveGrid's specific stage maturity relative to the Series C peer set, which sits one stage ahead and commands substantially higher multiples, and (2) the nascent, capital-intensive nature of climate technology, where peer valuations exhibit 4x dispersion even within adjacent stages. The stage-progression floor of $126M represents conservative progression; the peer-median ceiling of $1.0B reflects the company's positioning within an active, well-capitalized sector. A Series B valuation in the $300M–$700M range would align with staged capital efficiency assumptions.
